direction.depth_strategy: Graduated depth with wallpaper patterns expanding from the center to the edges
direction.border_or_perimeter_strategy: Soft, gradient-edged floral patterns at the border for a seamless transition

direction.short_design_rationale: This design direction aims to create a visually stunning and elegant background for a bridal celebration. The symmetrical floral pattern and central focal point provide a balanced and harmonious layout, while the reserved text zones ensure that any necessary overlays will fit seamlessly into the design.

direction.composition_strategy: Asymmetrical floral cluster with a receding depth and open perimeter, emphasizing a diagonal flow of floral elements.
direction.focal_strategy: A visually rich cluster of floral elements positioned in the upper left quadrant, drawing the eye diagonally across the composition.
direction.depth_strategy: Receding depth achieved through layering of floral patterns, with larger, more detailed blooms in the foreground gradually becoming smaller and more abstract in the background. A subtle gradient is employed to create a sense of atmospheric perspective.
direction.border_or_perimeter_strategy: An open perimeter, allowing floral elements to naturally 'escape' the frame, contributing to a sense of organic growth and movement. The edges are soft and blurred, avoiding a harsh boundary.
direction.title_safe_region_strategy: Lower third of the frame, left-aligned, reserved for title text.
direction.programme_safe_region_strategy: Bottom right corner of the frame reserved for programme text.

direction.short_design_rationale: This direction diverges from the central symmetry of Direction A by embracing an asymmetrical composition and a diagonal flow, creating a more dynamic and organic feel. The open perimeter and receding depth contribute to a sense of boundless beauty, suitable for a celebratory bridal event. The floral cluster serves as a focal point while allowing for calm negative space for typography.
